Ambedkar University Suspends 10 Students After Campus Clashes

Dr B R Ambedkar University has suspended 10 students following clashes that occurred during a protest and documentary screening. The university has barred the suspended students from entering its campuses while a disciplinary inquiry is pending. The university alleges property damage and physical altercations between students and security personnel during the incident. The All India Students' Association (AISA) has claimed that security personnel assaulted students.
